script: The key question is which skill you can practise every day for the next ninety days without feeling bored or stuck. Ask a friend who knows you well what she thinks you are good at, and write down her answer. Do not decide in one afternoon. Give yourself the week of trial lessons, and then decide with a clear mind. Some paths suit certain women. If you want the fastest start, choose data entry, and then move to virtual assistance. If you are creative, choose Canva design, then social media management. If you love language, choose content writing. If you work mainly on a phone, choose video editing. And two skills can work together. A social media helper who also designs in Canva can offer a complete package to a small shop. Write your choice in your notebook now.
